subject: Geo SKU prioritization + new SEA pilot sizing request
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Geo SKU prioritization + new SEA pilot sizing

Team —

We have three near-term commitments that require us to lock down dedicated capacity sizing and a go/no-go for a small SEA pilot region. High level:

- HelixAI (US) — deal estimate attached, contract signature expected by 12/15. They want a US-West dedicated pool with EU fallback.
- Nebula Systems (EU) — procurement window opens 1/10/27; they want EU capacity pinned for GDPR isolation.
- Orchid Labs (SG) — early-stage APAC pilot (3 month) with potential to expand to dedicated pool H2 if usage ramps.

Requests: please review the attached demand_model_v2.xlsx and customer_commitments.csv and provide the following by EOD Thursday (48 hrs):
1) Recommended node types (H100 vs A100) and counts per region (US/EU/APAC) for initial committed capacity and 20% buffer for burst.
2) Lead-time / procurement gating items (spare parts, cloud provider reservations, procurement approvals) we need to surface to Sales/Finance.
3) Suggested fallback lanes (region -> region) and any constraints for cross-region KV/cache migration.
4) A short ops action list for onboarding each customer (routing policies, SLOs, rollout canaries).

Attachments: demand_model_v2.xlsx (primary demand scenarios), customer_commitments.csv (signed LOIs / estimated QPS)

I'll synthesize and send to Sales + Finance for PO request once we have numbers. Prioritize Helix and Nebula for committed sizing; Orchid can be a small pilot but we need the node footprint and cost scenarios if they convert.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Dedicated Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Geo SKU prioritization + new SEA pilot sizing

Priya —

Quick read-through and initial numbers below (will follow up with a short spreadsheet):

HelixAI (US committed):
- Recommendation: 12 H100s (dense GPU hosts, 8 pods per host using 4-shard batching profile) to cover peak tokens + 20% burst.
- Rationale: Helix expects low-latency chat at 5k concurrent sessions; H100 gives better perf per watt for 8k seq workloads.

Nebula (EU committed):
- Recommendation: 8 A100s (for cost predictability) pinned in eu-west-1, plus 2 H100s for peak weekends.
- Rationale: Nebula is cost-sensitive; A100 quantized variant meets QoE; keep H100 headroom for sustained spikes.

Orchid (APAC pilot):
- Pilot footprint: 2 A100 nodes (pilot), with a surge bucket of 2 additional nodes in a nearby region (sg-sin or hk) — keep it as a soft reserve rather than dedicated until conversion.

Fallback lanes: US -> EU for Helix overflow; EU -> US only for non-personal data. APAC -> US fallback only if customer signs cross-border waiver.

Lead times / gating: GPU procurement / reservations vary by SKU — H100 procurement lead/vetting is ~10-12 weeks if on-prem; cloud reserved capacity can be requested in 2-3 weeks but discounts and tranche commitments take longer. Network peering and private link for Nebula will need security sign-off (~2 weeks).

I'll sync with Irene on infra constraints and k8s packing options, and we should lock host images/quant profiles early.

- Rishi
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 13:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Geo SKU prioritization + new SEA pilot sizing

Adding infra/ops perspective:

Node SKUs and memory profiles:
- H100 (80GB) recommended for Helix: large KV cache + long-context 32k-style offering. We should prefer H100 for any customer requesting >16k contexts.
- A100 (40GB) for Nebula and Orchid pilot; use int8/4 quantization profiles we've validated for the 30B family to reduce RAM and NVMe swap.

Operational notes:
- Batching: enable continuous batching for Helix but set per-tenant max latency guardrails (p95 < 220ms).
- KV cache: plan for a regional Redis cluster co-located with the compute; cross-region cache sync is not advisable for latency-sensitive routes.
- Canary plan: start with 10% traffic on dedicated pool then 50% -> 100% across 72 hours (automated rollback on >3% error rate).

Procurement & timeline risks:
- If we need bare-metal H100 racks, lead time is 10–12 weeks; cloud reserved instances can be booked faster but may require minimum 6–12 months commit for best pricing.
- KMS/HSM integration for Nebula (EU) may add 1 week for key onboarding and 1 additional week for compliance checks.

I'll attach a short ops checklist and packing rules separately. For now: H100 for Helix in US-West (12), A100s in EU (8 + 2 burst), APAC pilot 2 A100 plus 2 soft reserve.

-Irene
Director, Serving Infrastructure

From: Claire Santos <claire.santos@helixai.com>

Priya —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Confirming Helix's ask: dedicated US-West pool (preferred) with EU fallback for compliance-sensitive traffic. We expect production cutover 2027-01-20 and projected steady-state Q2 token consumption in the spreadsheet (see attached earlier).

Couple of clarifications:
- Can we get a separate SLA addendum for EU fallback routing? Our legal team will need explicit data residency language.
- For the pool sizing, can you provide an estimated monthly unit cost for the recommended 12 H100 setup (including baseline network and cache costs)?

If you can include an ops onboarding checklist + security controls for the EU fallback, we can move to signature.

Best,
Claire Santos
Head of Infrastructure, HelixAI
